decisions.reason: Retaining the I2C 0-ohm series resistors does not change the interboard connector partition, connector types, pinout, or pin-order policy.
The I2C series-resistor decision does not affect the switchable 5V boost rail, its enable control, or its sensor-power behavior.
The decision concerns I2C series resistors and does not alter the addressable LED family, data GPIO, power, or logic interface.
Retaining I2C series resistors does not change the native USB D+ and D- interface.
The I2C resistor population decision does not affect USB-C connector selection, compatibility, or sourceability.
Retaining the I2C series resistors does not change the selected four-layer PCB stack.
